title: Geopolitical Daily
preheader: Nepal's death toll passes 360 as a swollen glacial lake threatens more flooding.
intro_text: Good morning. It's Friday, August 28, 2026 — one story worth your full attention today, plus 8 quick updates from around the world.

stories.story_title: Himalayan Flash Flood Kills Hundreds, Leaves Over 1,400 Missing
stories.why_important: A flash flood on the Nepal-Tibet border has killed more than 360 people. Over 1,400 are missing, including 700 foreigners from more than 30 countries. Rescue crews had to pause work when an overflowing lake threatened new floods.
stories.what_overlooked: Coverage focuses on the death toll but gives little detail on the glacial lake that triggered the flood or the risk of it happening again.
stories.prediction: Watch for an updated death toll and word on the fate of missing foreign tourists within 72 hours.

quick_hits.text: Trump signed an order renaming Lake Ontario 'Lake America' amid a 50% tariff fight with Canada.
Norway's King Harald V, Europe's oldest monarch, died at 89; his son becomes King Haakon VIII.
Ratko Mladic, convicted of the Srebrenica genocide, died in UN custody after serving a life sentence.
Uganda's King Oyo Nyimba, crowned at age 3 in 1995, has died at 34, the Tooro kingdom announced.
Pakistan's PM Shehbaz Sharif said the Mecca defense pact with Saudi Arabia and Turkey sends a 'message of peace.'
A Dutch court gave a 66-year-old man life in prison for the 1994 massacre of 3,000 Tutsis in a Rwandan stadium.
The US designated UK-based Palestine Action, plus two other groups, as foreign terrorist organizations.
PM Modi will meet Putin and other leaders at the SCO summit in Kyrgyzstan next week.
